changelog: 1.8.0: Audio Tracks browser — commentary, descriptions, dubs, and other labeled extras across the whole library.
description: Fetches complete TMDB cast and crew for movies and series, groups people by department, and shows them in a polished accordion on Jellyfin Web item detail pages. Includes an Audio Tracks browser for commentary and other special audio, break bumpers with rotation, Library Stats, studio detail pages, and a playback character rail.
name: Full Crew
overview: Full cast and crew, audio-type browsing, stats, studio pages, rotating bumpers, and a playback character rail
